description.narrative: This operation (the “Project”) consists of total financing of up to US$20 million with a tenor of up to seven years for the company Royal América in Chile and Colombia. Of this total, US$15 million will be granted to Arrendamiento de Máquinas Royal Rental S.A. in Chile and US$5 to Royal Rental Colombia S.A.S. in Colombia. In both cases, the funds will be used mainly for the import of electrical equipment for subsequent lease or sale. Royal América is a regional group dedicated to the leasing of electrical machinery used in distribution centers and for the movement of industrial cargo, with more than 20 years of experience and operations in Chile, Colombia, and Ecuador. Through this Project, IDB Invest will be able to contribute to the development of green mobility in the logistics sector in Chile and Colombia, with an impact on sectors as: food, retail, agriculture, and industry, among others.
